title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #2

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What did Bharat place on the throne? (1 mark)
   A. A book
   B. Ram's sandals (paduka)
   C. A lamp
   D. A crown

2. What does Punarjanam mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rebirth
   B. A prayer
   C. A river
   D. A festival

3. What is the first line of the Kenyan National Anthem? (1 mark)
   A. Twameva mata cha pita twameva
   B. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah
   C. Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
   D. Ya Kundendu Tushara

4. Which of the five principles is about goals? (1 mark)
   A. Punarjanam
   B. Purushartha
   C. Paramatma
   D. Prarthana

5. How do you sit in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Sit cross-legged
   B. Kneel and sit on your heels
   C. Stand on your hands
   D. Lie down

6. Who asked that Bharat be made king? (1 mark)
   A. Mahaprajapati
   B. Ganga
   C. Sita
   D. Queen Kaikeyi

7. What did the wise men say about the swan? (1 mark)
   A. The one who saves a life has more right to it
   B. It should be sold
   C. The one who shoots it owns it
   D. It belongs to the king

8. Which plant is the holy basil? (1 mark)
   A. Tulsi
   B. Sal
   C. Beri
   D. Peepal

9. What should you wear for yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Loose and comfortable clothes
   B. Tight clothes
   C. Heavy boots
   D. A raincoat

10. What is a calendar? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A festival
   C. A kind of map
   D. A way of counting days, weeks and months

11. Amina pays Ksh 200 for sugar costing Ksh 150 and is given Ksh 100 change. How much extra did she get? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 100
   B. Ksh 150
   C. Ksh 50
   D. Ksh 200

12. Whom did Ram marry in the Bal Kaand? (1 mark)
   A. Saraswati
   B. Ganga
   C. Kaikeyi
   D. Sita

13. What should passengers do before boarding a vehicle? (1 mark)
   A. Push others
   B. Jump onto it
   C. Wait for the vehicle to stop
   D. Run alongside it

14. Narsimha is an Avtar of which god? (1 mark)
   A. Lord Buddha
   B. Lord Shiva
   C. Lord Ganesh
   D. Lord Vishnu

15. What should you do if you feel dizzy during yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore it
   B. Continue faster
   C. Hold your breath
   D. Stop at once

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why respect for a Mandir is important and how a visitor of any faith can show it. (5 marks)

17. Give two ways water is used at home. (2 marks)

18. What is the role of the bell in a Mandir? (2 marks)

19. State three reasons why the Saraswati Vandana is said by students. (3 marks)

20. Explain what Punarjanam means. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Ram's sandals (paduka)
   Bharat ruled in Ram's name.

2. A — Rebirth
   Punarjanam is being born again.

3. C — Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
   The anthem is Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu.

4. B — Purushartha
   Goals of life.

5. B — Kneel and sit on your heels
   You sit on your heels.

6. D — Queen Kaikeyi
   Kaikeyi reminded the king of two promises.

7. A — The one who saves a life has more right to it
   They said saving life is a greater right.

8. A — Tulsi
   Tulsi is the holy basil plant.

9. A — Loose and comfortable clothes
   Loose clothes help us move.

10. D — A way of counting days, weeks and months
   Calendars organise time.

11. C — Ksh 50
   Correct change is 50, so 100 minus 50 is 50 extra.

12. D — Sita
   Ram married Sita in Mithila.

13. C — Wait for the vehicle to stop
   Wait until it has stopped.

14. D — Lord Vishnu
   Narsimha is one of Lord Vishnu's Avtars.

15. D — Stop at once
   Stop and rest.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: A Mandir is a holy place. Visitors can remove shoes, dress modestly, speak softly, ask before photos and accept prasad politely. Respect brings peace among faiths.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for holy place, 3 marks for three ways, 1 mark for peace.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Drinking, cooking, washing, cleaning, watering plants or animals (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct use.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Worshippers ring it gently to announce that they have arrived.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for ringing, 1 mark for announcing arrival.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: To ask for a clear mind, good speech and love for reading, music and the arts (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punarjanam is rebirth. The soul does not die but takes a new body until it reaches Moksha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for rebirth, 1 mark for the soul, 1 mark for Moksha.
